thread:
incident-bot: PAGER · P0 authz anomaly detected · multiple edge nodes reporting 403 spikes on /v1/session/validate. ~120 distinct src IPs across us-east/us-west/eu-west. Possible session replay/mirroring. sample log: ```2026-03-18T02:10:12Z EDGE auth=403 tenant=acme session_id=sh_v1_abc123 src=54.23.12.99``` rate ~220/s. Auto-page oncall ryan.
ryan (oncall): I'm on it — creating ephemeral triage channel #inc-5209876543-ghost-sessions and pinging Eng-Security + Eng-SRE. Starting checklist.
alice (Eng-SRE): looking at edge-proxy headers and KV cache for session entries. Running quick scan of cache hit-rates.
ben (Eng-Security): question — are these successful logins (200) being reused elsewhere or failed (403) replay attempts? If replay, we need a signing-key rotation + revoke. Preparing KMS rotate plan.
charlie (Infra): I'll prepare temporary network mitigations (denylist top noisy CIDRs) and isolate suspicious edge-proxies. Applying config to edge-proxy-7/9.
ryan (oncall): Action items (short): 1) alice: collect sample request bodies and session_id list (script: `scripts/inspect_sessions.sh --pattern sh_v1_ --since 10m`) 2) charlie: apply blocks for CIDRs: 54.23.12.0/24, 3.120.45.0/24, 18.200.0.0/16 3) ben: prep key rotation + revocation plan 4) support-bot: gather affected customer list by tenant. I'll monitor and hand off after initial mitigation.
support-bot: querying support DB for recent activity on tenants with session samples, returning top hits (small list).
alice (Eng-SRE): quick findings — same session_id observed across 4 tenants within seconds, KV cache shows identical keys returned to different tenant namespaces. This looks like mirrored logs/requests being replayed, not legitimate reuse. Capturing sample bodies now.
ben (Eng-Security): coordinate with Legal. @jane (Legal) — could be exposure of PII in logs if request bodies contain email/identifiers. Need advice on disclosure and retention.
jane (Legal): joining call. Preserve logs, don't purge until we scope. If PII present or tokens leaked we may need to notify customers. Provide scope (tenants, time-window, sample payloads).
ryan (oncall): Starting controlled signing key rotation: staging rotate session_sign_v2 -> session_sign_v3 (test first), plan prod roll in 15m if green. Ben/Charlie, we need immediate revocation path for active tokens matching `sh_v1_%` pattern.
incident-bot: Runbook executed: session-replay-mitigation v1. Steps applied: temp rate-limit at edge, cache invalidation queued, token-strict mode enabled on auth API. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/session-replay-2026
alice (Eng-SRE): cache invalidation started (inv-id=inv-20260318-01), estimated completion 6m. grabbing sample request bodies (sanitizing PII).
charlie (Infra): iptables rules applied on edge-proxy-7 and edge-proxy-9. Confirmed mitigation effect: 403 spike reduced from ~220/s to ~28/s within 90s.
ben (Eng-Security): starting selective session revocation: `POST https://internal-auth/internal/revoke` payload: `{"pattern":"sh_v1_%","reason":"suspected-replay"}` — staging run ok, prepping prod start.
ryan (oncall): prepping customer comms draft for Support/CS if we confirm leaked tokens in logs. @support-bot: prepare affected-customer list with contact owners.
support-bot: returning list: tenant ids [acme, globex, novacorp] with last activity windows.
jane (Legal): hold on communications until we confirm contents of payloads. If tokens present, follow security disclosure template. Preserve chain-of-custody.
alice (Eng-SRE): sample payloads (sanitized): `{ "session_id": "sh_v1_abc123", "user": {"id":"redacted","email":"REDACTED"}, "meta": {"src":"54.23.12.99"}}` — there are email-like strings in some samples.
ben (Eng-Security): confirm — we need full key rotation. Initiating KMS rotate request now, will coordinate with infra for rolling restart window.
charlie (Infra): scheduling rolling restart for auth-api group-3 starting in 10m. Will keep canary traffic on for validation.
ryan (oncall): handoff note — I'll remain as incident lead for the next 25m, then hand to Ben for remediation closure and to Alice for post-mortem data collection. Next steps: finalize scope, finish revocations, complete key rotation, prepare customer impact statement if needed.
ben (Eng-Security): starting 30m postmortem tracker and collecting eval prompts to check for regressions.
jane (Legal): we'll standby for scope confirmation. If PII confirmed, legal will prepare notification recommendations and coordinate with Customer Success.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE · mitigation in progress · current symptom rate ~25/s · next auto-update in 10m.
